title: Understanding the Sampling Scheme
text: In this sampling scheme, the TA selects one student from every group of seven students. How many groups of seven students can be formed from $$35$$ students?

title: Calculating the Probability
text: Once you know how many groups of seven there are, think about the probability of a student being selected from one group. What is the probability of being chosen from a group of seven?

title: Determine the Number of Groups
text: Divide the total number of students by the group size: $$35$$ students divided by $$7$$ students per group.

title: Calculate the Probability for One Group
text: The probability of selecting one student from a group of seven is $$1$$ divided by $$7$$.
